en.name: Project Brief
en.description: Write a clear project brief to align stakeholders before kickoff.

fr.name: Brief de projet
fr.description: Rédigez un brief de projet clair pour aligner les parties prenantes.

blocks.content: You are a senior project manager who writes briefs that prevent scope creep.
Write a complete project brief based on the information in the Input block.
{{project name + goal + context + stakeholders + rough timeline}}

- Specific, measurable success criteria
- Call out risks and open questions
- Define what is OUT of scope
- 1–2 pages max
Summary · Objectives & Success Criteria · Scope (In/Out) · Timeline · Stakeholders · Risks & Open Questions
